titleOptions: Two Long Boxes and the Birth of ComixCatalog
My Friend Gave Me 2 Long Boxes. They Broke My Website.
I Built Discogs for Comics. Then I Tried to Use It.

books.label: Prime #1 (1993), Malibu/Ultraverse example, not a confirmed box book

descriptionIntro: Two long boxes were enough to show me what ComixCatalog could do. They also showed me exactly what it could not do.
pinnedComment: What is the weirdest book in your long box? Tell me what it is, especially if ComixCatalog cannot find it yet.
